question.problem:
$$
(\,∃k\in {R}^{+},\,{k}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{I}\end{aligned}}>t\,)⇒(\,∀{m}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{II}\end{aligned}}\in Q,\,{m}^{2}\ge {n}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{III}\end{aligned}}\,)
$$

Which occurrences of the variables in the expression above are free?
question.worked_solution:
Let's examine our expression and mark the occurrences of the variables as bound $(\text{b})$ or free $(\text{f}).$

- Occurrence I of the variable $k$ is *bound* since it lies within the scope of the quantifier $∃k$ that uses $k:$

$$
(\,∃k\in {R}^{+},\,\overset{\text{scope of }∃k}{\overset{⏞}{{k}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}>t}}\,)⇒(\,∀m\in Q,\,{m}^{2}\ge 10\,)
$$

- Occurrence II of the variable $m$ is *bound* since it is placed right next to the quantifier $∀:$

$$
(\,∃k\in {R}^{+},\,k>t\,)⇒(\,∀{m}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}\in Q,\,{m}^{2}\ge n\,)
$$

- Occurrence III of the variable $n$ is *free* since it isn't placed right next to a quantifier and it doesn't lie within the scope of a quantifier that uses $n.$

The occurrences of variables in the expression are as follows:

$$
(\,∃{k}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}\in {R}^{+},\,{k}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}\$\,\${t}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{f}\end{aligned}}\,)⇒(\,∀{m}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}\in Q,\,{{m}^{2}}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}\ge {n}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{f}\end{aligned}}\,)
$$

Therefore, the free occurrence is "III only."
